goal: Retrieve reducer'da verified refund/chargeback sonucunu payment state mutation transaction'ı içinde invoice review handoff'una bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin retrieve reducer wiring ve testini geri al; payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Only normalized verified refund/partial-refund/chargeback result can trigger invoice review
Payment state and invoice review mutation share one transaction boundary and tenant scope
Repeated retrieve result is idempotent and never deletes invoice/document or emits credit note
Non-refund retrieve results preserve existing handoff behavior
